```artifact
Feature: Alarms Handling in Controller and GUI

  Scenario: Controller detects and/or receives alarms from GUI
    Given the GUI sends an alarm signal
    When the controller processes the signal
    Then the controller detects the alarm

  Scenario: Controller commands the hardware PCB buzzer
    Given the controller receives an alarm signal
    When the controller commands the buzzer
    Then the buzzer is activated

  Scenario: GUI/Controller enumerates alarm codes and assigns them priorities
    Given the system has a set of alarm codes
    When the GUI/Controller enumerates and assigns priorities
    Then each alarm code is assigned a priority

  Scenario: GUI displays highest priority alarm on main screen
    Given the GUI has a list of active alarms with priorities
    When the GUI displays the highest priority alarm
    Then the highest priority alarm is displayed on the main screen

  Scenario: GUI displays list of active alarms on button press
    Given the GUI has a list of active alarms
    When the user presses the button
    Then the list of active alarms is displayed

  Scenario Outline: GUI displays alarm on main screen legible at distance of 1 meter
    Given the GUI displays an alarm with <alarm_code>
    When the user is at a distance of 1 meter
    Then the alarm is legible
    Examples:
      | alarm_code |
      | ALM001     |
      | ALM002     |
      | ALM003     |

  Scenario: High severity alarms are indicated with a red color and a flashing frequency of 2Hz with a 50% duty cycle
    Given the system has a high severity alarm
    When the GUI displays the alarm
    Then the alarm is indicated with a red color and flashes at 2Hz with a 50% duty cycle

  Scenario: Low severity alarms are indicated with a yellow color which is constantly on
    Given the system has a low severity alarm
    When the GUI displays the alarm
    Then the alarm is indicated with a yellow color and is constantly on
```
